description: This file is a shell script used to perform various tests outside a git repository, such as applying patches, computing diff hashes, and other git commands. It sets up a non-repo environment and verifies command behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expecting the provided commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the provided commands to fail.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes multiple lines to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for differences.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in files.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific status code.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets a global git configuration variable.
